After weeks of testing, WhatsApp is now officially rolling out its new in-chat search button for iPhone users. Here are the details.

Button appears when scrolling up

Earlier last month, WhatsApp began testing a new search button placed in the bottom-right corner of the chat interface, making it easier for users to launch a search.

Prior to this update, users who wanted to search within a chat had to first tap the contact or group name at the top of the conversation, then select the search option from the chat info page, and only then return to the main chat to enter their query.

The in-chat search button, by contrast, streamlines the process, letting users start a search instantly without leaving the conversation.

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp has now officially launched the in-chat search button, but its placement differs from what it was during the testing period.

Here's what WABetaInfo reported:

WABetaInfo notes that the new shortcut works in individual chats, group chats and Channels. In all three cases, when a user scrolls up in a conversation or channel, the button appears near the top of the screen; when the user scrolls back to the bottom, the button disappears.

As is the case with most WhatsApp feature rollouts, the new search button may take some time before it reaches all users.
